Subject: Project update: revised delivery date of 14 April

We're writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for certification has taken longer to clear than the vendor originally indicated, and that step has pushed the overall schedule back by two weeks. All other workstreams remain on track and unaffected.

Based on the certification timeline now confirmed with the vendor, we are setting 14 April as the new delivery date. Our team is monitoring the remaining certification steps closely to ensure this date holds, and we'll flag immediately if anything changes.

Does 14 April still work well with your own internal planning and any downstream commitments on your end? Let us know if you'd like to schedule a call to walk through the revised timeline in more detail, and we'll be happy to set that up.
